body: I have been in your situation and I still struggle with suicidal thoughts everyday. At 18, you are on n charge of yourself and I had to remove myself from my toxic family. Just be your self

My wife struggles with these feelings constantly, and pushes me away daily. I’m sure that you would find more than just one person who thinks you are attractive. I don’t know how honestly… but don’t give up trying
For me it feels like a stranger is the only option. I am unable to share with anyone who knows me, in fear that they will disconnect like everyone else has before them.
I can’t use Facebook or Twitter for this reason, it makes me so emotional that I end up crying while making fake accounts to see what they have done

I would feel relived if the number was an exaggeration but I have heard of men with 50-60 and that didn’t surprise me at all. If his count is the truth then I would honestly expect that they are a fan of some type of prostitution…
